item.title: Flowers Hospital welcomes first baby of 2026
item.description: DOTHAN, Ala (WDHN) -- Flowers Hospital in Dothan welcomes the first baby delivered in their ward in 2026. Arthur was born at 1:16 a.m. New Year's Day morning. The hospital congratulates parents Alex and Joanna.

item.title: Officer rescues puppy from trash compactor, then adopts him
item.description: A one-year-old terrier mix tossed into a self-compacting trash can was rescued just in time by a police officer — who days later returned to give the puppy a forever home.
